_comment: AXIS Brand Session Guard — Exemplo de sessão N1 completa após 3 batches (9 imagens aprovadas)

brand_config.name: AXIS
brand_config.segment: B2B Fintech — Plataforma analítica para gestoras de fundos
brand_config.visual_concept: Data as power topography — precision, authority, zero noise
brand_config.logo_concept: Two axes (X+Y) intersecting at 7° rotation, goldbar proportions

rejection_reasons: Rounded corners on cross symbol — violated no-rounded-corners rule
Gold too saturated (bright yellow) — must be burnished/muted (#C9A84C range)
Wordmark serif too decorative — required transitional, not display serif
Navy background too warm — required cool deep navy #0A1628
Symbol proportion not goldbar — horizontal was equal to vertical
Glow effect on intersection point — prohibited atmospheric effect
Background dark gray instead of navy — wrong surface color
Wordmark too thin, lost legibility at small scale
Cross symbol rotation incorrect (appeared horizontal, not 7°)

prompt_used.l1_symbol: Two perpendicular lines intersecting at their center point, rotated 7 degrees from the horizontal axis, forming a precise cross symbol. Lines are equal in visual weight, clean sharp edges. The intersection point marked by a small solid circle. Proportion: horizontal line is 1.618x longer than vertical (golden ratio). Rendered against deep navy background (#0A1628). Lines in burnished muted gold (#C9A84C). Style: Swiss International Style, Bauhaus, technical precision. No gradients, no shadows, no decorative elements. Clean vector-like rendering. High contrast, minimalist.
prompt_used.negative: rounded corners, organic shapes, glow, gradients, neon, warm background, yellow gold, decorative serif

rejection_reasons: M1: People visible in war room — prohibited (no humans in AXIS imagery)
M1: Screens showing colorful infographics — must be monochrome data terminals
M1: Warm ambient lighting — required cold, screen-sourced lighting only
M2: Compass rendered in chrome/silver — required dark steel or matte black
M2: Gold ingot replaced by coin — proportion wrong (must be rectangular bar)
M2: Background warm wood surface — required cool navy/matte black surface
M3: Grid topography too bright, overwhelming — must recede behind content
M3: Data towers rendered as 3D glass — required architectural matte forms
M3: Blue too saturated (neon) — required electric blue #4A9FD4 range
M2: Lifestyle feel crept in (coffee cup visible) — zero lifestyle props
M3: Perspective too steep, grid distorted unrealistically
M1: Sound/audio equipment visible — wrong domain for financial imagery

prompt_used.m1_war_room: Dark, high-contrast financial data room. Multiple screens displaying real-time market data — numbers, charts, line graphs. Bloomberg terminal aesthetic but more refined, more modern. Deep navy and charcoal color palette. Muted gold reflections on screen bezels. Cool white typography on screens. Monospace fonts, dense information hierarchy. No people visible — just the data itself. Dramatic raking light from screens. Black metal and glass surfaces.
prompt_used.m2_instruments: Flat lay of precision instruments on deep navy surface: technical drawing compass, set square. Mechanical pencil, fine-tip technical pen. Graph paper with coordinate grid. A rectangular gold ingot as compositional anchor. All objects: matte black or dark steel. Cold directional lighting from upper left. No lifestyle props.
prompt_used.m3_topography: Abstract data topography visualization. Cartesian coordinate grid rotated 7 degrees. Fine hairlines in soft electric blue. At grid intersections: small data points, some in muted gold. Rising landscape of data towers as architectural forms. Depth: closer grid brighter, farther fades to black.
prompt_used.negative: people, humans, faces, warm lighting, neon, chrome, wood, lifestyle, coffee, warm tones, colorful infographics

rejection_reasons: S1: Grid too visible, competes with imaginary content — must be 4% opacity max
S1: Gold hairline too thick (3px) — required 1px precision
S2: Cross symbol centered but scaled incorrectly — appeared too large
S2: Background not pure navy — purple tint crept into navy
R1: Number matrix numbers readable as content — must be purely textural
R1: Central zone not fully clear — texture leaked into content area
S1: Added decorative border to slide — violated no-frame rule
S2: Symbol glow added around cross — prohibited atmospheric effect
R1: Diagonal lines too prominent — must be hairline at 8% max
S2: Empty space felt incomplete rather than intentional — needs refinement of composition
R1: Format incorrect (generated as 4:3, not 1:1)

prompt_used.s1_dark_slide: Minimal dark editorial slide background. Deep navy base color. Extremely subtle coordinate grid — hairlines barely visible, 4% opacity. One horizontal precision hairline in muted gold, upper third. Very faint number matrix in right corner, opacity 5%. Zero focal point, pure atmosphere. No gradients, no glow. Flat, matte, dark. 16:9 format.
prompt_used.s2_gold_accent: Dark editorial slide with gold geometric element. Deep navy background, 90% of composition. Single cross symbol centered, in burnished gold, occupies 15% of slide area. Faint coordinate grid background. No text. Cinematic, authoritative, silent. Negative space dominates. 16:9 format.
prompt_used.r1_instagram: Square dark editorial composition. Deep navy background, full bleed. Top-right corner: subtle number matrix, financial decimals, opacity 5-8%. Three diagonal hairlines at 7 degrees, pale gold, opacity 8%. Bottom-left: small cross symbol in burnished gold, 15% opacity. Central zone 60% of composition: completely clear. 1:1 square format.
prompt_used.negative: glow, gradients, warm tones, readable text in texture, borders, frames, purple tint, oversaturated gold

assets.notes: Proporção goldbar correta. Rotação 7° precisa. Ouro muted perfeito. Usar como favicon e avatar.
Versão principal para fundos escuros. Símbolo em ouro, wordmark em off-white. Usar em header de site, deck, email sig.
Versão para fundos claros. Símbolo e wordmark em navy. Sem ouro (1 cor). Usar em impressão, papelaria.
Perfeito para hero section da landing page. Bloomberg terminal mood sem ser cópia. Nenhuma pessoa visível. Iluminação de tela impecável.
Flat lay impecável. Lingote de ouro retangular em proporção correta. Instrumentos em aço escuro matte. Usar em about page e materials de PR.
Abstrato. Grade azul elétrico e pontos dourados criam profundidade. Recua bem para uso como background. Usar em slides de abertura.
Fundo escuro minimalista para slides de dado. Grid em 4% opacidade. Hairline ouro no terço superior. Matrix textural imperceptível no canto. Zona central limpa.
Slide de capítulo com símbolo cross em ouro centralizado. Silêncio visual poderoso. Espaço negativo intencional. Usar como divisor entre seções de deck.
Background 1:1 para posts de dado no Instagram. Zona central limpa e segura. Diagonal hairlines dourados em 7°. Matrix no canto superior direito como textura. Pronto para overlay de texto/número.

cost_estimates.provider: Luma AI (estimate based on March 2026 pricing)
cost_estimates.note: Cost does not include brand strategist or copywriter time — those are separate from image generation. N1 level image generation cost is negligible relative to brand strategy work.

notes: Approval rate of ~22% is expected for high-fidelity brand with strict visual rules
Main rejection source: palette deviations (warm tones, oversaturated gold)
Second rejection source: atmospheric effects (glow, gradients) prohibited by AXIS rules
After batch-02, prompts were refined — batch-03 had tighter iteration loops
All 9 approved assets are production-ready without additional editing
